B(362.05,65.45) and D(361.95,405.56) lie on the circle and on the vertical x=362 through E(362.0,235.0), which is the foot of the perpendicular from B to AC, so BD is perpendicular to AC at E and E is the midpoint of BD. params.instruction:
Consolidate the geometry of this figure into GES objects and relations. Verified evidence:
- Full circle circle_01: center (263.39, 235.25) px, radius 196.56 px. Its center is the point O, labelled O at about (263.9, 235.1) px.
- Straight segments (image px, origin top-left): line_01 horizontal from A (67.25,235.25) to C (460.22,235.25), i.e. the diameter AC through O and E. line_02 from A to B, B near (362,65). line_03 vertical x=362 from B (362,58-65) down to D (362,405). line_04 from A to D (362,405.6). line_05 from B to C. line_06 from C to D. line_07 from B to O (265,234).
- Labels: A (67.25,235.25), O (263.91,235.12), E (362.0,235.0, the foot of the perpendicular from B on AC), C (460.22,235.25), D (361.95,405.56), B is the top vertex at about (362,65), which the CV left unlabelled but the inspected figure shows as B.
- Right-angle mark verified at E (vertex (362,235), arms along AC and BD). It is a square mark, so the figure has angle BEC = 90 degrees.
- Figure type: AC is a diameter, B and D are on the circle, and BD is perpendicular to AC at E. Dashed vs solid: all lines are solid.
- Do not add any other right angles. The perpendicular junctions at B and D have no verified square mark.
Output the consolidated objects (circle with center O and radius, points A B C D E O on the circle or the line as applicable, segments AB, AD, BC, CD, BD, AC, BO, OE implied by the segments above), plus the relations: AC diameter, E on AC and BD, BD perpendicular to AC at E, right angle at E. Also state the trimmed endpoints: segments should end at the vertices, and the 2-8 px overshoots should be snapped to vertices.
